newsitem.title: INDIA: India sees 97/98 export growth at 15 pct -PTI.
newsitem.headline: India sees 97/98 export growth at 15 pct -PTI.

text.p: India's Director General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) S.B. Mohapatra said on Tuesday exports are likely to grow at 15 percent in 1997/98 (April-March) compared with 4.01 in the previous year, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.
While Mohapatra said 15 percent growth in exports was likely, he also added that exports of over $40 billion in 97/98 was a realistic target, which would mean growth of just over 20 percent.
Exports in the last fiscal year stood at $33.11 billion while imports grew at 5.99 percent to $38.55 billion.
India's trade deficit in 96/97 shot up to $5.44 billion in 96/97 against $4.54 billion in the previous year.
